page.overview:
What is Reagent?

Reagent is a major antagonist in Interactive Novel #3: Escape the Pizzaplex. It is a S.T.A.F.F. Bot that was created to remove organic matter around Freddy Fazbear's Mega Pizzaplex using toxic gas.

Reagent is described to be a S.T.A.F.F. Bot with big dark gray metal, blank, buggy eyes and two "arms" that end in nozzles to spray out a toxic chemical within tanks attached to Reagent's back. It has wheels to help it move around the Pizzaplex.

Reagent was made to remove any and all organic matter from the Pizzaplex using a toxic chemical, described to have a sickening, chemical smell, that it has at all times on its back in tanks. Upon spraying at an alive being, it can burn the eyes and throat of whoever gets sprayed, sending them into vertigo and making their arms seemingly feel heavy, inevitably knocking them out for hours or killing them.
